title: onboard-orionx-lite-5b-v1.3-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Priya Shah
description:
Onboard orionx-lite-5b v1.3 to the model registry with full metadata, curated performance profiles, and automated changelog generation for release notes.

Context and motivation: orionx-lite-5b is a low-latency 5B variant used by several internal teams for chat and assistant flows. This PR adds canonical metadata that drives runtime kernel selection, compatibility tags for Dedicated/Private, and performance profiles used by the serving runtime to pick batching/quantization defaults. It also introduces a small automation script that appends structured release notes when model metadata or perf profiles change so downstream docs and release pages remain in sync.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add models/orionx-lite-5b/v1.3/metadata.yaml with tokenizer, supported sequence lengths, input/output schemas, and compatibility tags.
- Add models/orionx-lite-5b/v1.3/perf_profiles.json containing measured throughput/latency on representative hardware (A10, V100) and recommended default settings (batch_size, kv_cache_policy, quantize_profile).
- Add scripts/registry/auto_changelog.py: a small automation that detects metadata/perf profile changes and emits a canonical changelog entry to content/registry/changelog.md with model, version, and highlights. The script is guarded by a dry-run flag and unit-tested.
- Add tests/tests_models/test_orionx_metadata.py validating schema conformance and perf-profile sanity checks.
- Minor docs update to docs/model-registry.md describing new fields and deployment considerations.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata YAML follows schema v2.4 and passes schema validator.
- [x] Perf profiles populated from internal benchmark lab and annotated with measurement harness ID.
- [x] Automation script has unit tests and CI coverage.
- [x] Docs updated with runtime compatibility notes and rollout guidance.

Testing performed:
- Local schema validation and unit tests (pytest)
- Benchmarks run in perf-lab on A10 and V100 nodes (throughput/latency numbers included in perf_profiles.json)
- CI pipeline: lint, unit, integration (integration retried once due to transient timeout and passed)

Rollout and migration notes:
- The registry index will be updated automatically as part of the merge. Clients that pin models by version will not be affected. Runtime will prefer the new perf profile for v1.3 on supported hardware; fallback behavior remains unchanged for older clients.

Related work and links: Linear ENG-7181 (onboarding cadence), PM-224 (product validation), and SUP-901 (support case for low-latency model).
